title: Pick from a list in categories

steps.title: Keep a short list of id
steps.prompt:
IN ( … ) keeps a row when the value is in your list.
It is a shorthand for several OR tests.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM categories.
Add WHERE id IN (…).
Put the values inside the brackets, commas between.
Write: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3);

steps.title: Keep id NOT IN a list
steps.prompt: NOT IN ( … ) keeps the rows whose value is not in the list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM categories.
Add WHERE id NOT IN (…).
List the values in brackets.
Write: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4);
